verified_header_findings: All 78 reviewed member names and original member byte hashes have retained headers, including both extensionless files.
All 37 velocity files declare UCUR and VCUR in meter/second; all 78 TIME variables declare days since 1950-01-01T00:00:00Z.
Eight ADCP files contain time-varying DEPTH(TIME,BINDEPTH), error velocity, pitch/roll, heading and pressure-related variables.
Point-current-meter DEPTH is explicitly nominal; its comment requires PRES for time-varying instrument depth.
Header time_coverage_end values extend into September 2018. The earlier August-to-August README summary is not exact instrument coverage.
Header time bounds, dimensions and QC attributes have not been checked against actual time values, masks or observation arrays.

All 78 instrument license attributes contain citation and PI-contact-before-commercial-use language, whereas the repository landing page links CC BY 4.0. Both statements are retained; this review does not resolve their relationship.

closed_prior_findings.scope: Actual format compatibility proved for these 78 instrument headers only.
Complete archive custody, hash, directory fingerprint and exact header receipt now retained.

partially_addressed_prior_findings.scope: Actual variable IDs, units, accuracy, fill and flag attributes retained for all instruments. Interpretation and sample validity remain open.
